shots.generation_prompt: Create one continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 live-action commercial sequence, not an animation and not a montage of unrelated images. LOCATION AND CAST LOCK: a modest contemporary Chinese city design studio at dawn; one real East Asian male graphic designer about 28, short natural black hair, dark-gray knitted crew-neck sweater, ordinary believable face, visible pores and slight under-eye fatigue; the same warm-white ceramic coffee cup containing black coffee sits on the right side of his wooden desk in a diagonal stripe of window light. Keep his identity, clothes, desk layout, cup shape, cup handle direction, daylight direction and left-to-right screen axis unchanged for all internal shots. STORY GOAL: show that repetitive editing has stopped working and that he consciously chooses to pause; coffee is the object that catches his attention, not a magical cure. INTERNAL SHOT TIMELINE: 0.0–2.8s — over-the-shoulder medium close shot from behind his left shoulder, 50mm lens, a physical monitor is visibly framed inside the real office; the screen contains a plausible abstract poster layout made only from soft neutral blocks and guide lines, no readable words. His right hand makes one restrained mouse drag, hesitates, then performs one undo; [slow dolly in], only about ten centimetres, stable tripod feeling. 2.8–5.4s — action-matched hard cut to a close insert of his mouse hand and the bottom edge of the monitor; he tries one final small adjustment, the cursor-like glow moves slightly, his fingers slow down and become still; [static], shallow but natural depth of field, no floating UI and no full-frame graphic panel. 5.4–7.7s — hard cut on the same axis to a side-profile medium close shot; he exhales subtly, releases the mouse, lowers his hand onto the desk, shoulders relax by only a few centimetres; his performance is restrained and natural, never theatrical. 7.7–10.0s — remain in the same profile setup and make a very gentle [pan right] following only his eye line as he turns his eyes first and then his head toward the warm-white coffee cup in the sunlit right side of the desk; rack focus slowly from his eye to the cup; do not show him drinking or standing. Hold the final 0.5 seconds with his gaze fixed on the cup and his right hand still near the mouse, ready for the next segment. PHOTOGRAPHY: real live-action location photography, neutral low-saturation colour, honest dawn exposure, practical monitor light, 35mm cinema camera, 50mm lens, mild sensor grain, natural skin texture, realistic hand anatomy, subtle camera breathing and physically plausible inertia; looks like documentary crew footage captured in a real office, not glossy synthetic AI advertising. AUDIO POLICY: no speech, no lip movement; leave room for keyboard clicks fading into quiet HVAC and distant city ambience. NEVER SHOW: anime, illustration, CGI person, 3D render, plastic skin, beauty filter, model face, perfect facial symmetry, ancient costume, silver hair, fantasy glow, orange-teal grading, luxury showroom office, extra people, women or children, painting or drawing at an easel, repeated coffee drinking, sudden intelligence, identity or wardrobe change, cup mutation, deformed fingers, readable generated text, countdown digits, fake logo, watermark, whip pan, orbit, crash zoom or shaky camera.

shots.generation_prompt: Create one spatially continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 live-action advertising sequence in the exact same modest Chinese design studio and dawn light as the previous segment. CONTINUITY LOCK: the same real East Asian male designer, age about 28, short black hair, dark-gray knitted sweater, same face and body; the same warm-white ceramic cup filled with black coffee, same rounded handle and proportions; the workstation remains to screen left and the window remains to screen right. He starts seated, already looking at the cup, with his right hand just beginning to reach toward its handle. The whole segment is one causal action: reach, pick up once, stand, take a few steps to the window, notice the real relationship between the cup shadow and window-grid shadow, then turn back toward the workstation. He never drinks. INTERNAL SHOT TIMELINE: 0.0–2.4s — close three-quarter desk shot continuing the previous eye line; his right hand travels at natural speed from beside the mouse to the cup, fingers wrap around the handle with anatomically correct contact, and he lifts the cup once; [short truck right] follows the hand and cup by a small distance, desk and window remain spatially stable. 2.4–5.2s — action-match cut to an eye-level medium shot; he rises naturally while holding the cup below chest level and walks two or three unhurried steps toward screen right; [slow tracking right] beside him with gentle gimbal stability, no orbit, no speed ramp; workstation stays visible behind him on screen left to preserve geography. 5.2–7.6s — cut as he places the cup gently on the wooden window ledge, without releasing it completely; high-angle macro insert, 85mm lens: morning sunlight casts a physically plausible shadow of the cup body and rounded handle across rectangular window-grid shadows. He rotates the cup only a few degrees once with two fingers; [static]. The handle shadow shifts and creates a clear asymmetric visual balance; real optics only, no glow, symbols or magic. 7.6–10.0s — cut to a restrained profile close shot on the same axis; his eyes compare the cup-handle shadow, the rectangular window grid and the distant building edges, moving in that order; recognition is shown only by his breathing settling and brow releasing slightly, not by smiling or exaggerated surprise. Keeping the cup in his right hand, he turns his shoulders toward screen left and looks back to the workstation. [very slow dolly out] reveals the desk in the background. Hold final 0.5 seconds with him facing left, ready to walk back. PHOTOGRAPHY AND REALISM: real person filmed on a practical location, natural pores, slight skin and hair imperfections, realistic cloth folds, neutral low-saturation colour, soft dawn side light with protected highlights, 35mm cinema camera, normal shutter motion, mild grain, physically correct weight transfer, hand grip, coffee surface and shadows. Quiet observational commercial, not an AI fantasy film. AUDIO POLICY: no dialogue, no lip movement; ceramic lift sound, two or three soft footsteps, distant morning traffic. NEVER SHOW: drinking, repeated cup lifting, coffee splash, supernatural inspiration, glowing particles, anime, illustration, 3D render, plastic skin, beautified influencer, ancient or fantasy clothes, extra people, identity change, sweater change, cup colour or handle mutation, deformed hands, impossible shadow direction, unrelated painting activity, readable text, logo, watermark, aggressive zoom, orbit, whip pan or handheld shake.
